code: select * from ECOLI_DATA order by SIZE_OF_COLONY desc

select size_of_colony
from ECOLI_DATA
order by size_of_colony desc
limit count(*) / 4

select size_of_colony
from ECOLI_DATA
order by size_of_colony desc
limit  4

SELECT id,
CASE NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY size_of_colony DESC)
    WHEN 1 THEN 'CRITICAL'  
    WHEN 2 THEN 'HIGH'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'MEDIUM'
    ELSE 'LOW'
END AS colony_name
FROM ecoli_data
ORDER BY id;
